description: This source file defines an abstract generic class 'GeneralizedValueTypeSurrogateCodec' which implements serialization logic for value types 'TField' with the help of a surrogate type 'TSurrogate'. It provides methods to read and write the types, as well as abstract methods for converting between the field type and the surrogate type.

classes.name: GeneralizedValueTypeSurrogateCodec
classes.description: An abstract generic class providing serialization logic for value types, using surrogate types and serializers. Supports reading and writing of value types with conversion methods to/from surrogate types.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a value of type TField from the reader, using the surrogate serializer and conversion from surrogate to field type.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a value of type TField to the writer, converting it to its surrogate form and writing it with proper wire protocol markers.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a surrogate value to the actual field value.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a field value to its surrogate form.
